business_summary.text: Anuh Pharma is a bulk drug (API) manufacturer at Tarapur with an R&D facility at Mahape, making macrolides, anti-TB, anti-bacterial, anti-malarial, anti-hypertension and corticosteroid APIs, with about 46% of FY26 revenue from exports.

call_points.text: FY26 revenue rose 15.66% to ₹776 Cr on volume growth and regulated-market expansion.
Other income fell to ₹4.36 Cr in FY26 from ₹9.46 Cr, cutting into PBT.
USFDA inspection completed in 2026 with zero 483 observation; EU GMP also completed.
Three products under development: Vonoprazan Fumarate, Pretomanid and Edoxaban Tosylate.

guidance.statement: The company anticipates a steady growth rate of 15-20% per annum.

operating_notes.text: Secured WHO Prequalification for anti-malarial API Amodiaquine Hydrochloride USP targeting WHO-procured and donor-funded programmes.
Board recommended final dividend of ₹1.50 per share (30%) for FY26.
Promoter, promoter group and PAC held 7,19,56,044 equity shares of Anuh Pharma as on 31 March 2026, with no encumbrance during FY26.
FY26 total production was 1,733 MT, up 24.99% YoY, at high plant utilisation.
Tarapur facility has 9 API blocks and 2 intermediate blocks with total capacity of 2,400 MTPA.
Exports were about 46% of FY26 revenue; top five customers contributed 31%.
Board approved investment in manufacturing assets for capacity expansion and availing a loan of up to ₹75 Cr on October 13, 2026.
Asset Transfer Agreement executed to purchase Tarapur manufacturing facility from Vanquest Pharma for ₹72.90 Cr, adding 525 MTPA capacity.
Bulk drugs and chemicals remains the company's only primary reportable segment under Ind AS 108.

timeline.summary: Received WHO Prequalification (WHO PQ) approval for anti-malarial API Amodiaquine Hydrochloride USP.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹202.12 Cr (+2.0% YoY), net profit ₹11.68 Cr (-6.3% YoY).
Anuh Pharma board approved the re-classification of nine promoter group shareholders to the public category.
Anuh Pharma's promoters declared holding of 7,19,56,044 equity shares as on 31 March 2026 with no encumbrance during FY26, under SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4).
Anuh Pharma's FY26 investor presentation reported revenue of ₹776 Cr (+15.66%) and EBITDA of ₹66.08 Cr (-6.09%), with management guiding 15-20% annual growth.
Anuh Pharma's board approved a ₹75 Cr loan and investment in manufacturing assets for capacity expansion on October 13, 2026.
Signed an Asset Transfer Agreement to acquire Vanquest Pharma's Tarapur API facility for ₹72.90 Cr, expanding capacity by 525 MTPA.
Anuh Pharma received possession of Vanquest Pharma's Tarapur manufacturing facility on 21 October 2026 under an asset transfer agreement executed on 16 October 2026.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹185.24 Cr (-0.3% YoY), net profit ₹11.21 Cr (+47.3% YoY).
